mapper.select: SELECT lev_nm, lev_ul, lev_cd FROM level WHERE lev_cd like '%BUYERMENU%' AND lev_yn = 'y' ORDER BY lev_so

SELECT p.prd_cd, s.sel_nm, p.prd_nm, CONCAT(ROUND(((p.prd_op - p.prd_sp) / p.prd_op) * 100, 0), '%') AS dc, FORMAT(p.prd_op, 0) AS prd_op, FORMAT(p.prd_sp, 0) AS prd_sp FROM products p JOIN sellers s ON p.sel_id = s.sel_id
WHERE prd_cd = #{prdCd};
SELECT c.cod_nm, o.clr_nm, o.prd_qt FROM options o JOIN common_detailcode c ON o.siz_nm = c.cod_cd WHERE prd_cd = #{prdCd}

SELECT sl.sel_nm, sl.sel_if, pi.fil_pt, pd.prd_nm FROM sellers sl JOIN products pd ON sl.sel_id = pd.sel_id RIGHT join product_images pi ON pd.prd_cd = pi.prd_cd WHERE pd.prd_st = '승인' AND sl.sel_nm = #{sel_nm};

SELECT pd.prd_nm ,pi.fil_pt, pd.prd_op, CONCAT(ROUND(((pd.prd_op - pd.prd_sp) / pd.prd_op) * 100, 0), '%') AS dc, FORMAT(pd.prd_sp, 0) AS prd_sp FROM products pd JOIN sellers sl ON pd.sel_id = sl.sel_id JOIN product_images pi ON pd.prd_cd = pi.prd_cd WHERE sel_nm = #{sel_nm} AND prd_st = '승인';

SELECT pd.prd_nm, pd.sel_id, pd.prd_cd, CONCAT(ROUND(((pd.prd_op - pd.prd_sp) / pd.prd_op) * 100, 0), '%') AS dc, FORMAT(pd.prd_sp, 0) AS prd_sp, pd.prd_bd, pi.fil_nm, pi.fil_pt FROM products pd JOIN product_images pi ON pd.prd_cd = pi.prd_cd WHERE prd_nm LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query},'%') AND prd_st = '승인';
SELECT * FROM level WHERE lev_cd like 'CATEGORY%' AND lev_yn = 'y' ORDER by lev_cd, lev_so;

WITH RankedImages AS ( SELECT prd_cd, fil_nm, fil_pt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY prd_cd) AS rn FROM product_images ) SELECT i.fil_nm, i.fil_pt, s.sel_nm, p.prd_cd, p.prd_nm, FORMAT(p.prd_op, 0) AS prd_op, FORMAT(p.prd_sp, 0) AS prd_sp, p.prd_bd, p.prd_ca, p.prd_dt, r.count, w.buy_em FROM products p LEFT JOIN (SELECT prd_cd, fil_nm, fil_pt FROM RankedImages WHERE rn = 1) i ON p.prd_cd = i.prd_cd LEFT JOIN sellers s ON p.sel_id = s.sel_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT prd_cd, COUNT(*) AS 'count' FROM options o JOIN reviews r ON o.opt_id = r.opt_id GROUP by prd_cd) r ON p.prd_cd = r.prd_cd LEFT JOIN (SELECT w.buy_em, w.prd_cd FROM wishlist w JOIN buyers b ON w.buy_em = b.buy_em WHERE w.buy_em = #{buy_em}) w on p.prd_cd = w.prd_cd WHERE 1 = 1
AND p.prd_ca = #{lev_cd}
ORDER BY 1
ORDER BY r.count DESC
ORDER BY p.prd_dt DESC
ORDER BY prd_sp DESC
ORDER BY prd_sp

SELECT c.cod_nm, o.prd_qt, FORMAT(p.prd_sp, 0) AS prd_sp FROM options o JOIN products p ON o.prd_cd = p.prd_cd JOIN common_detailcode c ON o.siz_nm = c.cod_cd WHERE o.prd_cd =#{prd_cd} AND o.clr_nm = #{color}
SELECT lev_cd, lev_nm, lev_ul FROM level WHERE lev_cd LIKE 'MyPage%' AND lev_yn = 'y' ORDER BY lev_so
SELECT buy_em, buy_nm, buy_ph, buy_bd, buy_nn, buy_gn, buy_ht, buy_wt FROM buyers WHERE buy_em = #{buy_em};

SELECT p.prd_cd, s.sel_nm, p.prd_nm, p.prd_sf, CONCAT(ROUND(((p.prd_op - p.prd_sp) / p.prd_op) * 100, 0), '%') AS dc, FORMAT(p.prd_op, 0) AS prd_op, FORMAT(p.prd_sp, 0) AS prd_sp, pi.fil_pt FROM products p JOIN sellers s ON p.sel_id = s.sel_id JOIN product_images pi ON p.prd_cd = pi.prd_cd WHERE p.prd_cd = #{prd_cd};
mapper.update: UPDATE buyers SET buy_nm = #{buy_nm}, buy_ph = #{buy_ph}, buy_bd = #{buy_bd}, buy_nn = #{buy_nn}, buy_gn = #{buy_gn}, buy_ht = #{buy_ht}, buy_wt = #{buy_wt} WHERE buy_em = #{buy_em}
mapper.select: SELECT r.rev_ca as rev_ca, r.rev_id, r.rev_rt, r.rev_ct, p.prd_nm, c.cod_nm, o.clr_nm, b.buy_em, b.buy_nn, b.buy_ht, b.buy_wt FROM reviews r JOIN buyers b ON r.buy_em = b.buy_em JOIN options o ON r.opt_id = o.opt_id JOIN products p ON o.prd_cd = p.prd_cd JOIN common_detailcode c ON o.siz_nm = c.cod_cd WHERE r.buy_em = #{buy_em} ORDER BY rev_ca DESC

WITH RankedImages AS ( SELECT prd_cd, fil_pt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY prd_cd) AS rn FROM product_images ) SELECT p.prd_nm, i.fil_pt, cd.cod_nm, od.odd_qt, o.clr_nm, o.opt_id FROM order_details od JOIN options o ON od.opt_id = o.opt_id JOIN common_detailcode cd ON o.siz_nm = cd.cod_cd JOIN products p ON o.prd_cd = p.prd_cd JOIN (SELECT prd_cd, fil_pt FROM RankedImages WHERE rn = 1) i ON p.prd_cd = i.prd_cd WHERE odd_id = #{odd_id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reviews(rev_id, buy_em, opt_id, rev_rt, rev_ct, rev_ca) VALUES(DEFAULT, #{buy_em}, #{opt_id}, #{rev_rt}, #{rev_ct}, DEFAULT)
mapper.select: SELECT r.rev_id, rei_pt FROM reviews r JOIN review_images i ON r.rev_id = i.rev_id WHERE r.buy_em = #{buy_em}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review_images (rei_id, rev_id, rei_nm, rei_pt, rei_ca) VALUES (default, #{rev_id}, #{fil_nm}, #{fil_pt}, NOW())

mapper.select: WITH RankedImages AS ( SELECT prd_cd, fil_pt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY prd_cd) AS rn FROM product_images ) SELECT rp.vie_tm, p.prd_cd, p.prd_nm, p.prd_sp, p.prd_op, s.sel_nm, i.fil_pt FROM recently_products rp JOIN products p ON rp.prd_cd = p.prd_cd JOIN sellers s ON p.sel_id = s.sel_id JOIN (SELECT prd_cd, fil_pt FROM RankedImages WHERE rn = 1) i ON p.prd_cd = i.prd_cd WHERE buy_em = #{buy_em} ORDER BY vie_tm DESC LIMIT 6
